label: outermostGroup: the deepest hit is returned at every scope
exitOneLevel: exit goes to the root instead of one level
lockedPicksNothing: a layer under a locked group is picked
find: guard let ancestors = tree.ancestors(of: hit), !tree.isEffectivelyLocked(hit) else { return nil }
replace: guard let ancestors = tree.ancestors(of: hit) else { return nil }

label: outsideScopePicksNothing: the scope's ancestry is not checked
find: guard chain.count > depth, Array(chain.prefix(depth)) == scope.path else { return nil }
replace: guard chain.count > depth else { return nil }

label: enterNeedsChildren: an empty group can be entered
enterDirectChild: a group deeper than the scope is entered
find: tree.ancestors(of: id) == scope.path else { return nil }
replace: tree.ancestors(of: id) != nil else { return nil }
